# KDE syntax-highlighting notice

The distributed catalog is owned by the optional
`SharpVision.SyntaxHighlighting` package. Its packaged `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`
lists every embedded definition's exact upstream filename, language name, and
license, grouped by license, with the pinned source commit. Full
permissive-license texts ship in the package's `licenses/` directory.

`SharpVision.SyntaxHighlighting` is an independent reimplementation of the Kate
syntax-highlighting engine against the KDE project's public XML schema; no C++
source code from `KDE/syntax-highlighting` is compiled into or redistributed by
SharpVision. Only the data files identified above are redistributed, and only
under their own stated permissive licenses.
